purpose: Frozen selected-v6 real-source score-dependence diagnosis after identical JPEG-q96 and stretch preprocessing; not model selection.

visual_inspection.scope: Four highest or representative authentic scores; bounded qualitative diagnosis.
observations: The highest-scoring LAION real is a watermarked anatomical stock render rather than an ordinary camera photograph.
The second-highest LAION real is abstract artwork in a frame.
The highest-scoring CIFAKE reals inspected are tiny 32 by 32 animal photographs enlarged for inference.
A high-scoring SID real is a low-contrast parking-lot photograph with glare and heavy cloud cover.
visual_inspection.boundary: These examples suggest low-resolution, non-photographic and ambiguous-authentic content weaknesses. They do not prove the causal feature used by the model.

boundary: The repeated first and second Qwen gates use the same 288 authentic rows, so identical real-source score statistics are confirmation of file reuse, not an independent real-side replication. A high variance share proves source-dependent scores, not a metadata shortcut or hidden-set failure.
